description: This file is a Makefile for building the musl C library within an OpenWrt build system. It defines build configurations, variables, include directives, and custom build and clean targets specific to the musl package.

methods.name: Host/Configure
methods.description: Sets up the configuration for building musl on the host system, including linking the source directory, removing any old cache, and running the configure script with specified options.

methods.name: Host/Clean
methods.description: Cleans the build environment by removing build directories related to musl and its dependencies.
